units.title: 天气图卡：太阳、月亮、雨与雪

materials.title: Four picture cards
materials.text: Look at picture cards A, B, C and D. Match each English word or phrase to one picture. Use every letter once.

questions.explanation: B是带有光芒的太阳，sun为太阳；A是雨滴、C是雪花、D是月亮，均不符合sun。
questions.instruction: Look at the four picture cards. Choose the matching letter.

materialImages.label: Picture cards A, B, C and D

questions.explanation: D是弯月，moon为月亮；A雨、B太阳、C雪花与月亮不同。
questions.instruction: Look at the four picture cards. Choose the matching letter.

materialImages.label: Picture cards A, B, C and D

questions.explanation: A画的是落下的水滴，rain为雨；B是太阳、C是雪花、D是月亮，均不是雨。
questions.instruction: Look at the four picture cards. Choose the matching letter.

materialImages.label: Picture cards A, B, C and D

questions.explanation: C是两朵雪花，snow为雪；A为液态雨滴，B太阳，D月亮，不能与snow对应。
questions.instruction: Look at the four picture cards. Choose the matching letter.

materialImages.label: Picture cards A, B, C and D

units.title: 交通图卡：自行车、火车、巴士与小汽车

materials.title: Four picture cards
materials.text: Look at picture cards A, B, C and D. Match each English word or phrase to one picture. Use every letter once.

questions.explanation: C车身较长，有多扇乘客窗，是bus；A自行车没有封闭车身，B有轨道及相连车厢为火车，D短车身为小汽车。
questions.instruction: Look at the four picture cards. Choose the matching letter.

materialImages.label: Picture cards A, B, C and D

questions.explanation: B有机车、相连车厢和轨道，为train；A自行车、C巴士、D小汽车均没有这组轨道车厢特征。
questions.instruction: Look at the four picture cards. Choose the matching letter.

materialImages.label: Picture cards A, B, C and D

questions.explanation: A有两个细轮、车架、脚踏和车把，是bicycle；B火车、C巴士、D小汽车均非自行车。
questions.instruction: Look at the four picture cards. Choose the matching letter.

materialImages.label: Picture cards A, B, C and D

questions.explanation: D为短车身、有车顶和四轮的小汽车car；A自行车、B火车、C多窗巴士与之不同。
questions.instruction: Look at the four picture cards. Choose the matching letter.

materialImages.label: Picture cards A, B, C and D

units.title: 餐桌图卡：碗、勺子、盘子与杯子

materials.title: Four picture cards
materials.text: Look at picture cards A, B, C and D. Match each English word or phrase to one picture. Use every letter once.

questions.explanation: D为有侧把手的杯子cup；A无把手且较宽深的碗、B长柄勺子、C平盘都不是此杯。
questions.instruction: Look at the four picture cards. Choose the matching letter.

materialImages.label: Picture cards A, B, C and D

questions.explanation: B有长柄和椭圆勺头，是spoon；A碗、C盘、D杯均没有长柄勺头。
questions.instruction: Look at the four picture cards. Choose the matching letter.

materialImages.label: Picture cards A, B, C and D

questions.explanation: A画的是有深度的碗bowl；B是勺子，C为从上方看的平盘，D有把手是杯子。
questions.instruction: Look at the four picture cards. Choose the matching letter.

materialImages.label: Picture cards A, B, C and D

questions.explanation: C为圆形平盘plate；A深碗、B勺子和D有把手杯子均不是平盘。
questions.instruction: Look at the four picture cards. Choose the matching letter.

materialImages.label: Picture cards A, B, C and D

units.title: 衣物图卡：帽子、外套、靴子与短袖上衣

materials.title: Four picture cards
materials.text: Look at picture cards A, B, C and D. Match each English word or phrase to one picture. Use every letter once.

questions.explanation: A是戴在头上的帽子hat；B有袖和纽扣是外套，C为脚上的靴子，D为短袖上衣，均不是帽子。
questions.instruction: Look at the four picture cards. Choose the matching letter.

materialImages.label: Picture cards A, B, C and D

questions.explanation: B为长袖、前面有纽扣的外套coat；A帽子、C靴子、D短袖上衣不符合该词。
questions.instruction: Look at the four picture cards. Choose the matching letter.

materialImages.label: Picture cards A, B, C and D

questions.explanation: C是两只高帮靴子boots；A帽子、B外套、D短袖上衣都不是足部穿着的靴子。
questions.instruction: Look at the four picture cards. Choose the matching letter.

materialImages.label: Picture cards A, B, C and D

questions.explanation: D为圆领短袖T恤T-shirt；A帽子、B前排扣长袖外套、C靴子与短袖T恤不同。
questions.instruction: Look at the four picture cards. Choose the matching letter.
